abstract: In short, the comparison of the arms gives these main findings. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel reduces side effects compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel reduces side effects compared with Standard care.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. All data for this comparison were collected at the Harbor Street Patients.

Table 5. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.
